next.reason: 1985 says only what the generic terms identification-division, environment-division, data-division, procedure-division and end-program-header in the source-program format stand for. 2023 §2023:10.6.1 does the same for its format: 'where the following meta-language terms are described in the indicated subclauses' lists data-division (13), environment-division (12) and procedure-division (14), and the program-definition format writes the IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header and the END PROGRAM marker out literally. The terms denote the same divisions and end marker; no program changes meaning.
